raw_response: {"diagnosis": "On 2026-01-15 the v2 collector began rolling out. It emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy rows (and all history) are in America/Chicago local time. The pipeline casts both as-is, so v2 rows land 6 hours late: transactions appear at 00:00-06:00, and the evening ones spill into 2026-01-19. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time, which is CST (UTC-6) for all dates in this January data, so silver keeps its existing local-time meaning.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
